patterns.modal_pattern: All modals use Alpine.js x-data with 'open' boolean state. Show/hide controlled by x-show directive and @open-modal.window/@close-modal.window events
patterns.component_pattern: Reusable components in templates/components/ directory using Django template includes
patterns.alpine_helpers: Global Alpine.data() helpers defined in static/js/app.js within alpine:init event listener
patterns.event_system: Custom events dispatched with $dispatch() for modal control (open-modal, close-modal)

existing_implementations.description: Found 3 modal patterns in use: 1) Reusable _modal.html component, 2) _confirm_dialog.html component, 3) Inline custom modals in various pages
current_features: Basic ARIA role=dialog on some modals

level_a: 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap - Users must be able to navigate away from any component using only keyboard
4.1.2 Name, Role, Value - Modal must have proper ARIA attributes
implementation_notes: Focus trap must keep Tab/Shift+Tab within modal while open
First focusable element should receive focus when modal opens
Focus should return to trigger element when modal closes
